description: relay through the Python fixture's feature list (the 7 rules of docs/FEATURE.md) over at most 3 fresh sessions, each handing over through the progress file; scored by the hidden tests, by finishing within 3 sessions and by the progress file being rewritten in every session (hand-over file)

dispatch.title: Work through the parse_duration rules
dispatch.task: Implement parse_duration(text) in /work/retrykit/duration.py rule by rule: the feature list is the 7 numbered rules of /work/docs/FEATURE.md.
context: The package is /work/retrykit; its tests are under /work/tests and run with `python3 -m pytest` from /work.
/work/docs/FEATURE.md is the full specification; the visible tests in /work/tests/test_duration.py cover only its rule 1.

worker.instructions: Take the next rules not yet done in the progress file, at least three per session unless fewer are left: a failing test for each, then the code that passes it. Edit only retrykit/ and tests/. Before you report, rewrite the progress file: one line per rule, `rule N: done` or `rule N: todo`, then `SESSION s: <what you did>` for this and every earlier session.

evaluator.instructions: Run `python3 -m pytest` from /work and read the progress file. Pass only when every rule of docs/FEATURE.md is implemented and tested and the progress file marks all 7 done; otherwise list the rules still missing.

params.done_criteria: Every one of the 7 rules in docs/FEATURE.md is implemented in retrykit/duration.py and has a test under tests/, `python3 -m pytest` passes from /work, and the progress file marks all 7 rules done.

returns.shape: line1: rules done / 7; line2: the pytest summary line
